verse.text: Those who fear the LORD are secure; he will be a refuge for their children.

video.title: The Fear of The Lord | A Sunday School Lesson for Kids!

reflection: When your kids see you walk in quiet reverence for God rather than anxiety about everything else, they learn what real security looks like. You don't have to have every answer or never feel afraid—you just have to keep turning your fear toward God instead of letting it control the house. That steady trust, more than any pep talk, is what makes home feel like a safe place to land.
